overview.title: Las dunas doradas del Erg Chebbi
overview.p1: Erg Chebbi represents the iconic image of the Moroccan Sahara: breathtaking ridges of golden-orange sand rising up to 150 meters high, stretching across the horizon near Merzouga.
overview.p2: Visiting the dunes rewards a slower pace. Watch how the shifting sunlight transforms the colors of the sand from pale gold at noon to deep amber and fiery red at sunset.
overview.p3: Whether you explore via camel trek, 4x4 safari, or by hiking to the highest summit, Erg Chebbi offers an unforgettable wilderness experience.

food.title: Dining Around Erg Chebbi
food.p1: Desert dining combines traditional camp tagines, hotel hospitality and local village meals.
food.li1: Welcome mint tea served upon arrival in the dunes
food.li2: Traditional Moroccan tagines cooked over open coals
food.li3: Berber pizzas baked in sand ovens
food.li4: Hotel restaurants and cafés in Merzouga village
food.li5: Fresh seasonal fruits and Moroccan pastries
food.p2: Most desert camp stays include half-board dining, as dining options directly in the deep dunes are limited to organized camps.

tips.title: Practical Tips for Visiting Erg Chebbi

1.title: Sun & Sand Protection
1.desc: Bring sunglasses, sunscreen, and a traditional scarf (shechiah) to protect against sun and blowing sand.

2.title: Licensed Guides
2.desc: Book camel treks and 4x4 desert tours through reputable local hotels or certified camp operators.

3.title: Warm Layers
3.desc: Desert temperatures plummet after sunset — always pack a jacket or fleece for the night.

q1.question: ¿Cuánto tiempo en el Erg Chebbi?
q1.answer: La mayoría pasa al menos medio día o una noche para vivir dunas, atardecer y amanecer.

q2.question: ¿Hay entrada de pago?
q2.answer: No, las dunas son espacios naturales gratuitos. Tours, treks y campamentos tienen tarifas aparte.

q3.question: ¿Mejor momento?
q3.answer: Temprano por la mañana y final de tarde para la luz y temperaturas más suaves.

q4.question: ¿Se pueden subir las dunas?
q4.answer: Sí, subir las dunas altas (hasta 150 m) es popular sobre todo para el atardecer.

q5.question: ¿Qué llevar puesto?
q5.answer: Ropa ligera de día, gafas, pañuelo y capas abrigadas de noche.
